failure_class: strictly-feasible root whose symmetric finite-difference stencil crosses a public semantic guard

implementation.typed_rescue: only central-stencil failures explained by public guard crossing or bounds crossing may use a unique branch-interior same-side chart
fd_proof_chart_no_rescue: rank or h/h2 discretization failure while constructing or checking a proof
bx failure while checking a proof
callback budget exhaustion during FD/proof/chart construction
callback exception or nonfinite FD/proof/chart sample
non-guard semantics failure in an FD/proof/chart sample
branch-token change in an FD/proof/chart sample
implementation.jacobians: second-order h/h2 residual and normalized-public-guard Jacobians, central or one unique same-side one-sided chart
implementation.correction: p_h2 Armijo with the only allowed alphas 1,1/2,1/4,1/8 and at most three accepted corrections
implementation.armijo_invalid_trial_policy: after a proof exists, retain E1's general charged invalid-trial backtracking: a full-alpha trial with invalid public guard, changed branch token, or other invalid semantics is rejected and the next fixed alpha is tried; never fabricate a penalty residual, change the proof, or try an alpha outside the fixed list
implementation.guard_model: directly evaluate c=z+p_h2 and require the empirical h/h2 root-radius guard lower model to exceed a normalized 64eps threshold for every strict public guard
implementation.result_type: LOCAL_HEURISTIC_GUARD_INTERIOR; never certified, validated, or an answer authority
implementation.shadow: bit-identical callback, chart, proof, Armijo and guard-model trajectory; return original LM endpoint

forbidden_runtime_inputs: case, family, file, primitive, or plugin identity

pre_outcome_counterexamples.positive_margin: linear, curved, and coupled residual structures at normalized strict margins 1e-6, 1e-8, and 1e-12 must retain the root
pre_outcome_counterexamples.boundary_ghost: F(t)=t, g(t)=t from a residual-qualified positive endpoint must be UNKNOWN because the predicted root is on the strict boundary
pre_outcome_counterexamples.near_rank_large_step: F_epsilon(x,y)=(x,epsilon*(y-1)), epsilon=5e-13 at (0,0), must retain E1's bx UNKNOWN
pre_outcome_counterexamples.oscillatory_guard: a guard with invalid h/2 samples and no unique interior side must be UNKNOWN
pre_outcome_counterexamples.armijo_backtracking: for public-guard, branch-token, and non-guard-semantics variants, alpha=1 is invalid and alpha=1/2 is valid; candidate and shadow must query the same fixed alpha sequence and report identical callback work
pre_outcome_counterexamples.finite_sample_alias: two guards identical on every deterministic probe but with opposite between-probe validity must demonstrate that HEURISTIC is not a proof
metamorphic: public guard tuple reorder and opaque token relabel
guard raw margin and scale multiplied by the same positive factor
residual row scaling with matching declared scale

nonproof_boundary: Without validated derivative/remainder bounds, h/h2 agreement cannot exclude an oscillatory guard between samples. This candidate may emit only a heuristic local endpoint for later canonical 512/768-bit validation.
